title: A2 2026
overview: Apu and Durga drift through a surreal world shaped by unfulfilled dreams and fractured identities, mirrored by the illusory lives of Shankar and Neeta. As reality and illusion blur, the story traces the quiet erosion of the human soul. Through Durgas alter ego, a haunting cry emerges, reflecting the pain, exploitation, and dislocation of a woman struggling to reclaim her sense of self in an unforgiving world.
